caseName: Missouri, Kansas & Texas Railway Co. v. Wise
caseNameFull: MISSOURI, KANSAS & TEXAS RAILWAY COMPANY v. WISE
syllabus: Writ, of error to review a judgment of the state court, in an action for personal injuries dismissed, without opinion, for want of jurisdiction.
summary: ERROR TO THE SUPREME COURT OP THE STATE OP TEXAS.
attorneys: Mr. James Hagerman, Mr. J. M. Bryson, and. Mr. Cecil H. Smith for the plaintiff in error., Mr. C. B. Randell and Mr. Judson PL. Wood for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction.
